name: hidden_contexts
kind: Recurring hidden contexts, each flagged only by a background rate on the eyes and each with its own secret food colour, so a bigger rung needs more context-to-colour associations kept apart and retained across returns.
source: outside_set2 29 (hidden context with a covert cue), 12 (Continual World: recurrence and forgetting), 27 (Harlow learning sets); outside_set 20 (renewal), 14 (Continual World), 33 (volatility)

rungs.text:
(world (meta (group heldout))
 (let K 1) (let i 0) (let j 0) (let s 0) (let ctx 0) (let visit 0) (let cur P)
 (table rule K 1 P) (table hop 2048 1 (int (max 1 (- K 1))))
 (told cur)
 (on birth
  (repeat K (put rule i (if (= (mod i 2) 0) P F)) (set i (+ i 1)))
  (repeat K (set i (- i 1)) (set j (int (+ i 1))) (set s (at rule i)) (put rule i (at rule j)) (put rule j s))
  (set ctx (int K)) (set cur (at rule ctx)))
 (on tick
  (if (chance (* 0.1 TICK)) (do (set ctx (mod (+ ctx 1 (at hop (mod visit 2048))) K)) (set visit (+ visit 1))))
  (set cur (at rule ctx)) (set poison cur)
  (repeat (poisson (* (pow 3 (mod ctx 3)) TICK)) (pulse 0))
  (repeat (poisson (* (pow 3 (floor (/ ctx 3))) TICK)) (pulse 1))))
rungs.desc: 1 hidden context(s), recurring at random (exponential dwell, mean 10 s, always moving to a different context when K > 1). Each context shows as a steady background pulse rate on the two eyes (each 1, 3 or 9 per second, by context number) and has its own secret food colour, half the contexts each way, drawn at birth and independent of the cue. Mapping to learn: 1.0 bits; cue reading about 1 nat/s at worst; about 400 tastes per context before the last third of the life. Told arm: told the poison colour of the moment.
